/*

#include "config.h"

#if HAVE_RVV

    .text

/*
 * void ff_pred16x16_dc_8_rvv(uint8_t *src, ptrdiff_t stride);
 * Computes DC from top[0..15] (src - stride) and left[0..15] (src[-1 + y*stride])
 * and fills 16x16.
 */
    .globl ff_pred16x16_dc_8_rvv
    .type  ff_pred16x16_dc_8_rvv, @function
ff_pred16x16_dc_8_rvv:
    /* a0=src, a1=stride */
    addi    t0, a0, 0               /* base dst */
    sub     t1, a0, a1              /* top row address */

    /* set vl=16 bytes */
    li      t2, 16
    vsetvli t2, t2, e8, m1, ta, ma

    /* sum top[0..15] */
    vle8.v  v0, (t1)
    vwaddu.vx v1, v0, zero          /* u16 */
    vsetvli t3, zero, e16, m1, ta, ma
    vredsum.vs v2, v1, v2
    vmv.x.s t4, v2                  /* t4 = sum_top */

    /* sum left[0..15] scalar loads */
    addi    t5, a0, -1              /* left column pointer */
    li      t6, 16
    li      t7, 0
1:
    lbu     t8, 0(t5)
    add     t7, t7, t8
    add     t5, t5, a1
    addi    t6, t6, -1
    bnez    t6, 1b

    add     t4, t4, t7              /* sum_top + sum_left */
    addi    t4, t4, 16
    srli    t4, t4, 5               /* dc */

    /* broadcast dc to v0 (u8) */
    vsetvli t2, zero, e8, m1, ta, ma
    vmv.v.x v0, t4

    /* store 16 bytes per row, 16 rows */
    li      t6, 16
2:
    vse8.v  v0, (t0)
    add     t0, t0, a1
    addi    t6, t6, -1
    bnez    t6, 2b

    ret
    .size ff_pred16x16_dc_8_rvv, .-ff_pred16x16_dc_8_rvv

#endif /* HAVE_RVV */

#
# RISC-V optimized DSP functions
#

OBJS-$(CONFIG_H264PRED)                   += riscv/h264pred_rvv.o

patches.diff:
--- a/libavcodec/riscv/h264pred_init_riscv.c
+++ b/libavcodec/riscv/h264pred_init_riscv.c
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+/*
+ * RISC-V optimizations for H.264 intra prediction
+ */
+
+#include <stddef.h>
+#include <stdint.h>
+
+#include "config.h"
+#include "libavutil/attributes.h"
+#include "libavutil/cpu.h"
+#include "libavutil/riscv/cpu.h"
+#include "libavcodec/h264pred.h"
+
+#if HAVE_RVV
+void ff_pred16x16_dc_8_rvv(uint8_t *src, ptrdiff_t stride);
+#endif
+
+av_cold void ff_h264_pred_init_riscv(H264PredContext *h, int codec_id,
+                                     const int bit_depth,
+                                     const int chroma_format_idc)
+{
+#if HAVE_RVV
+    int cpu_flags = av_get_cpu_flags();
+
+    if (bit_depth == 8 && (cpu_flags & AV_CPU_FLAG_RVV)) {
+        h->pred16x16[DC_PRED8x8] = ff_pred16x16_dc_8_rvv;
+    }
+#endif
+}

--- a/libavcodec/riscv/Makefile
+++ b/libavcodec/riscv/Makefile
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+#
+# RISC-V optimized DSP functions
+#
+
+OBJS-$(CONFIG_H264PRED)                   += riscv/h264pred_rvv.o

--- a/libavcodec/h264pred.h
+++ b/libavcodec/h264pred.h
@@ -133,4 +133,6 @@
 void ff_h264_pred_init_loongarch(H264PredContext *h, int codec_id,
                                  const int bit_depth, const int chroma_format_idc);
+void ff_h264_pred_init_riscv(H264PredContext *h, int codec_id,
+                             const int bit_depth, const int chroma_format_idc);
 
 #endif /* AVCODEC_H264PRED_H */
